videos.title: The Malaysian Tiger
videos.overview: Sandokan and his crew board a ship and free a captive, who is convinced the pirate is the warrior from an old prophecy. Landing in Labuan in disguise, Sandokan meets Marianne, the consul's daughter and clashes with Brooke, a pirate hunter.

videos.title: The Pearl of Labuan
videos.overview: Marianne is celebrating her twenty-first birthday. Sandokan and Brooke are invited to the ball. Tension builds between the three, but Sandokan must first free Yanez and his crew, imprisoned in the dungeons, and try not to blow his cover.

videos.title: Hostage
videos.overview: Sandokan sets his sights on the Sultan's antimony mines. Brooke and Murray are hunting him. Marianne, shocked by the events, finally opens her eyes to the atrocities committed by the English in the colonies, and her worldview changes.

videos.title: Singapore
videos.overview: Sandokan and his crew find refuge in Singapore. Brooke and Murray are hot on their trail. During the Lunar New Year, Marianne discovers more human Sandokan connected to his roots. Tensions reach boiling point and the Sultan intervenes.

videos.title: The Heart of the Jungle
videos.overview: While Brooke attempts to regain the consul's trust, Sandokan and Marianne reach a Dayak village deep in the Sarawak jungle. There, Sandokan faces a severe test that forces him to confront his true identity, long buried.

videos.title: In the Dark
videos.overview: In the jungle, the village chief helps Sandokan rediscover his past, while the Sultan's troops and Brooke close in. A shocking revelation threatens his friendship with Yanez and his love for Marianne, while Brooke decides to act alone.

videos.title: Death of a Pirate
videos.overview: Sandokan faces the Sultan in a decisive duel, while Marianna confronts her father and must choose whether to trust Brooke. When she discovers that Sandokan is in danger, her heart wavers. Yanez is also called upon to make a choice that will change his destiny forever.

videos.title: The Cost of Victory
videos.overview: Amid betrayals and unexpected alliances, Brooke plots to seize power and conquer Marianna. Sandokan and Yanez, meanwhile, prepare for the decisive battle for freedom, an epic clash that will forever mark the birth of the legend of the Tiger of Malaysia.
